message_1_subject: Intro + demo invite: Redwood inference for PilotCloud
message_1_body:
Hi Jamie,

Thanks for taking time to explore Redwood. I’ve scheduled a 30-minute demo for next Monday, Sep 27 at 09:00 PT to walk through the Dedicated offering and how it could help PilotCloud reduce inference cost for your search ranking use case.

I attached a short deck you can skim beforehand. If that slot doesn’t work, let me know and I’ll send a few options.

Agenda (30 min):
- Quick context (3 min)
- Live demo: routing + cost controls (15 min)
- Qs + next steps (12 min)

Thanks — looking forward,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf
message_2_subject: Re: Intro + demo invite: Redwood inference for PilotCloud

2) Join staggered office-hours slots I’ll host Tue & Thu 2–4pm PT (pick a 20-min block).
3) I can record a 12–15 min cut of the demo and follow up with a short sync.

I dropped a short calendar poll here: https://cal.poll/pilotcloud-availability so you can pick whatever is easiest. If you prefer I can loop in Vanessa from our CS team to coordinate a hands-on session for engineers.

Sorry we missed you — want me to hold a 20-min slot later today?

— Mateo
